chunks: Put your hand in the bosom of your shirt; it will come out white without any blemish. This will be one of nine tokens for the Pharaoh and his people, who are a wicked lot indeed.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the white hand miracle in Surah An-Naml?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of 'Ayat' (signs) as both miraculous proofs and divine attributes, with the 'white hand' symbolizing purity and the removal of the 'disease' of polytheism. The mention of 'nine signs' is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi as referring to the ten plagues or specific miracles, emphasizing the gradual revelation of divine power to a stubborn people. This event underscores the theme of divine authority confronting earthly tyranny, a central motif in the narrative of Musa (AS).
